title: Quenched Polish Fry Pancakes
description: A twist on traditional pancakes, featuring crispy fry bits, tangy cider vinegar, and a hint of Polish spirit.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, yeast, and salt.
Warm the milk to 105°F and mix in the egg.
Combine the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients and mix into a smooth batter.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it is elastic and smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle to 375°F.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and roll each one into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a pancake shape and place in the skillet.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
While the pancakes are cooking, heat the vegetable oil and fry in a pan until crispy.
Drain the fry and sprinkle over the pancakes.
Drizzle the cider vinegar over the pancakes and serve warm.
